title: The Non-Instrument Based Preparation of Tissue Samples Destined for Imaging Mass Spectrometry \(IMS) Analysis
protocol: Prepare nitrocellulose slides by cutting ITO slides according to size of sublimator.
Coat cut ITO slides with a layer of liquid nitrocellulose (40 mg/ml in 100% acetone).
Section the desired tissue at 12 µm and thaw or float mount onto the surface of the nitrocellulose.

Wash the whole slide sequentially with 75% ethanol, 95% ethanol, Carnoy’s fluid, 95% ethanol, de-ionised water, and 95% ethanol. Each wash is for 30 seconds except for Carnoy’s fluid which is for 2 minutes.
Place the slide into a small plastic beaker containing 20 mmol Tris-HCl (pH 8.8).
Cook the slide in a pressure cooker (70 kPa internal pressure at >100°C) for 15 min.
Remove the slide and allow it to dry and cool at room temperature.
Pipette 10 µl of Trypsin (1 mg/ml in water) onto the center of the tissue section.
Use surface tension to 'drag' the trypsin solution droplet across the entire tissue section, being careful not to scratch the tissue.
Place the slide in a fan-forced oven at 25°C with a dust filter over the top to protect from keratin contamination and allow it to dry.
Place sample slide in custom vapour chamber as previously described by O’Rourke et al.
Evenly pipette 650 µl of a 50:50 mix of 50 mmol ammonium bicarbonate/100% acetonitrile onto the center paper tab of the chamber.
Seal the chamber with para-film and leave at 37°C overnight.
Disassemble the chamber, remove and weigh the slide.
Mount the slide onto the cooling finger of the sublimation apparatus.
Place 300 mg of appropriate matrix evenly into the bottom petri dish of the sublimator.
Assemble the chamber.
Evacuate the chamber to ~25 mtorr.
Pack the cooling finger with ice and allow it to settle for 5 minutes.
Place the sublimator into an oil bath at an appropriate temperature.
Allow sublimation until a coverage of 0.2 mg/cm² is achieved.
Disassemble the chamber quickly and remove the slide to prevent condensation forming.
Allow the sample to return to room temperature.
Mount the sample into the vapor chamber again.
Evenly pipette 650 µL of 50:50 100% ACN: 0.1% TFA onto the paper tab, ensuring proper alignment with the slide.
Leave the setup at 37°C for 1 hour.
Disassemble the chamber and remove the slide.
The sample is now ready for analysis in the mass spectrometer.
